joints.name: Shoulder
joints.note: Flexion about the mediolateral axis, then abduction about the anteroposterior axis, then rotation about the humeral axis (intrinsic order); angles relative to the trunk. Clavicle and scapula follow with a fixed scapulohumeral rhythm (scapula rotates by 1/3 of the humeral elevation)

joints.name: Sternoclavicular (coupled)
joints.note: coupled: clavicle elevation = 1/12 of the humeral elevation

joints.name: Acromioclavicular (coupled)
joints.note: coupled: scapular upward rotation = 1/4 of the humeral elevation

joints.name: Elbow
joints.note: hinge about the transepicondylar axis

joints.name: Forearm rotation
joints.note: radius rotates about the line radial head - ulnar head; 0 = neutral (thumb up, AAOS)

joints.name: Wrist
joints.note: flexion about the radio-ulnar axis of the wrist, then radial/ulnar deviation about the axis normal to the palm; carpal bones move with the hand (no intercarpal motion)

joints.name: Hip
joints.note: flexion, then abduction, then rotation about the femoral axis (intrinsic order); angles relative to the pelvis frame (hip centres, sacrum, hip bones)

joints.name: Knee
joints.note: hinge about the transepicondylar axis (no tibial rotation / screw-home in this preview)

joints.name: Patella (coupled)
joints.note: patella follows 60% of the knee flexion angle about the same axis (ASSUMPTION, Hehne 1990-type ratio)

joints.name: Ankle
joints.note: talocrural hinge through the malleolar tips

joints.name: Ankle (subtalar)
joints.note: subtalar axis after Inman (1976): 42 deg above the horizontal, 23 deg medial to the foot axis, through the inferior talus (literature axis, not fitted)

regions.name: Lumbar spine
regions.note: Zero = the spine as built; the displayed range is the regional average range of motion, shared between the levels (equal shares; the C1/C2 joint carries 50% of cervical rotation, the occiput/C1 joint 20% of flexion) - ASSUMPTION

regions.name: Thoracic spine
regions.note: Zero = the spine as built; the displayed range is the regional average range of motion, shared between the levels (equal shares; the C1/C2 joint carries 50% of cervical rotation, the occiput/C1 joint 20% of flexion) - ASSUMPTION

regions.name: Head / neck (cervical spine + atlanto-occipital)
regions.note: Zero = the spine as built; the displayed range is the regional average range of motion, shared between the levels (equal shares; the C1/C2 joint carries 50% of cervical rotation, the occiput/C1 joint 20% of flexion) - ASSUMPTION

ankle_inv: AAOS: inversion 0-35, eversion 0-15 (the clinical value is subtalar + transverse tarsal together; all given to the subtalar joint here, ASSUMPTION)
cerv_flex: AAOS: cervical flexion 0-45, extension 0-45 (AMA 5th: 50 / 60) - includes the atlanto-occipital joint (head)
forearm_sup: AAOS: pronation 0-80, supination 0-80, zero = neutral (thumb forward), AMA 80/80
lumb_rot: White & Panjabi: lumbar axial rotation ~5 each side
shoulder_abd: AAOS: abduction 0-180; adduction 0-30 (AMA 5th: 50 cross-body) - 30 used (ASSUMPTION: from the side, in the frontal plane)
shoulder_rot: AAOS: internal 0-70, external 0-90 (arm at the side)
thor_rot: AAOS thoracolumbar rotation 0-45 each side, mostly thoracic (ASSUMPTION: 35)

rig.notes: joint centres from the page's bones (hip / shoulder: head sphere fit RMS 0.7-0.9 mm; ...); 49 segments, 22 joints, 386 skinned structures of 686
